Tests: the two suites plus one seeded offender each.
commits: One PR: package and non-package changes in separate commits (isolated-basalt-ui). Conventional, empty scope, no feat!:, no attribution. Generated files come from make check, never by hand. The Makefile line is the non-package commit.
